explicitRequirements.evidence: The deployed API Center product/platform/language entry set is authoritative.
Migrated HTML documentation must be substantive local MDX under zh-CN/api-reference.
Product order, platform order, page structure, and sidebar structure must match the legacy site.
Placeholders, redirects, and old-site body-link substitutes are not accepted.
Migration output and audit reports must be generated and maintained by scripts.
Inconsistencies must be recorded in frontmatter and summarized in generated reports.

technicalDecisions.evidence: 182 pages preserve an existing API Reference layout over a stale mapped path; 345 already-migrated pages outside API Reference remain unowned and unchanged.
54 platform routes project to shared local MDX through explicit existing-target mappings.
130 pages remain generated from maintained local OpenAPI sources; 5 changed short descriptions derive from legacy text and 1 preserve pre-existing target copy with formatting-only changes.
7 runtime product/platform labels are injected from the API Center source inventory instead of inferred from directory slugs.
7 non-product root navigation items keep their exact base-branch labels and routes.
客户端 and 服务端 action qualifiers are shortened from the live source group headings 客户端 API and 服务端 API.
(current) remains a filesystem grouping and is omitted from public routes.
9 root actions share targets; the overview retains all 91 live actions.
